transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I, um, I hope I'm in the right place for this. 

I'm just having some trouble at work—I operate a truck over at the warehouse. It's a bit embarrassing to talk about, to be honest, and I really don't want you to think I'm... well, you know, strange or making things up. But it's the routing system we use. It just feels like it isn't just a normal computer to me anymore. 

I've noticed that it's been marking my moves. It sends these little messages through the barcode scanners, and I know it's doing it to push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands there. 

Does that make sense? I know it probably sounds a bit silly out loud, I just... I hope I'm explaining it okay.
Do you believe, even now, that the routing system is intentionally targeting you or trying to push you out of your job?

I... well, yes, I do still believe that. I'm sorry, I know it must sound completely irrational to a professional like you. I really don't want to come across as difficult or... or paranoid. 

But it's just so hard to ignore. When I'm out there on the floor, it really feels like the system is, well, watching me. Like it's tracking everything I do, specifically me, and using the scanners to send those little signals. I just... I feel like they want to replace the older guys with something newer, and this is how they're doing it. 

I know it's a lot to take in. Am I making any sense at all, Doctor? I really hope I'm not wasting your time with this.
Outside of this situation with the routing system at work, have you ever had any other unusual or strange beliefs that others might not understand or agree with?

No, no, nothing like that. I really try to keep a level head about most things. I mean, I'm just a regular guy, you know? I go to work, I come home... I don't go around thinking wild things or anything. 

I really hope you don't think I'm completely out of touch with reality. It's just this one thing at the warehouse, because I'm there every day and I see it happening. But other than that, no, I haven't had any other... strange thoughts. I'm pretty normal otherwise, I promise. Is that... is that okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever experienced seeing, hearing, or sensing things that others don't, like hearing voices when no one is around or seeing things that aren't there?

I... um... well. I really want to be completely honest with you, Doctor, because I know you're just trying to help me. I don't want you to think I'm crazy or anything, I really don't. 

Sometimes... and it's probably just stress, you know? Just the stress of the job getting to me. But sometimes, even when I'm at home, just sitting out in my garage with everything shut off and quiet... I hear things. 

It's like the dispatch radio from work. I hear these voices, clear as day, calling out my operator number. And they... they say things like I'm dangerous, or that security is on their way to come get me. 

I know how that sounds. I really do. I try to just ignore it and tell myself it's just my mind playing tricks on me because I'm so worried about losing my job. It's not like I'm seeing ghosts or anything like that. It's just the radio voices. 

Does that... does that make me sound terrible? I hope I'm not giving you the wrong impression. I'm really trying my best here.
When you hear these voices on the dispatch radio at home, do they happen even when there’s no actual radio turned on or any device playing those sounds?

Yeah, um... yes, exactly. There's no radio on. I make sure everything is turned off in the garage, just so I can have some peace and quiet, you know? But... I still hear them. 

It's just the dispatch voices, calling my operator number... saying I'm dangerous and that security is coming. I know it's not a real radio playing, because I checked. I really did check. I just... I guess my brain is just so used to hearing it all day at work that it just keeps playing it back to me? Like a song stuck in your head, maybe? 

I know it sounds bad, hearing things that aren't there. I'm sorry if that makes me seem... unstable. I really am trying to handle it. Do you think it's just the stress causing it? I hope I'm not making things too complicated for you to figure out.
When you hear those dispatch voices at home, are there absolutely no devices or external sources that could be producing those sounds, like a radio, phone, or TV?

Yeah... yeah, I'm absolutely sure. I really wish there was a radio on, to be honest. It would make me feel a lot less... well, you know. 

But no, I go out to the garage specifically because it's quiet. I make sure the car radio is off, my phone is inside the house, no TV, nothing. It's just me and the silence. And then... there they are. The dispatch voices. Clear as day, just like I'm sitting on the forklift. Calling my number, saying I'm dangerous, saying security is on the way. 

I really hope you understand I'm not trying to be difficult or make up stories. I know how it sounds. I just want to be a good patient and give you the right answers. I mean, it's just stress, right? A lot of guys my age get stressed and hear things... right? I'm just trying to make sense of it all so you can help me. I'm doing okay, aren't I?
